reply_text:
Gist: The lag you're seeing is built in, for two reasons. Your "No, there's no point" turn only went to 象 when my reply to it ended, at 01:11:25, and 象 is still reading it: the record is marked `requested`, with its summary attached. Also, the stepper only reloads when you press `g`, and I reloaded it before that turn had even been sent. So it can only ever show turns 象 has finished reading, as of the last `g`. Shall I make it reload by itself when a reading for its session arrives? That would be one call from the code that already stores 象's result, with no timer or watcher.

**Why the "I still see" turn is the newest one shown:** the stepper leaves out unread turns. The "no point" turn is unread, so the newest complete frame is the one before it.

**What an automatic reload would change:** each frame would appear a few minutes after the agent's reply ends, which is how long 象 takes to read a turn. You wouldn't need to press `g`. The frame would still never appear while a turn is in progress, which is the behaviour you asked for earlier.
